about: OpenRouter's image, video and speech models as media-generator offers them. Kept by hand: add, remove or fix a model here. The models OpenRouter's catalog has and this list lacks are added by providers/openrouter.js (read at each start of the dashboard's server and once a day, cached in ~/.cache/media-generator/openrouter-catalog.json), this list wins for the models it has. Resolutions low to high, ratios tall to wide, durations in seconds; null means the model sets it itself. role: image create (words only), both (words and optional images), edit (needs an image); video generate, edit, upscale, avatar. references: the reference images it takes (a video model's apart from its frames, from the providers' docs on 2026-10-30; null when unknown). min_pixels: the smallest video it takes as a source, in pixels (null when unknown); a smaller one is scaled up before it goes. Aleph 2's minimum is 140 c, not the 56 c OpenRouter lists: 2 s and 4 s edits were both billed $1.40 on 2026-10-30. pricing: OpenRouter's own lines, for the estimates
